description.name: Entry
description.text: Seven single attacks (0.90 each) capped at 19999, grants [Damage Cap +10000], [Tri-Element Mode II (Fire, Ice, Lightning)], [Dual Awoken Spellblade Mode I (Steiner)], [Spellblade Resonance +5% Boost] and [Instant Cast 1] to the user

description.name: Dual Awoken Spellblade Mode I (Steiner)
description.text: Spellblade abilities deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, Spellblade abilities trigger 2 additional times, cast speed x2.00/x2.50/x3.00 and critical chance =50%/75%/100% for equipped Spellblade abilities after casting 1/2/3+ Spellblade abilities

description.name: Dual Shift
description.text: Grants [Instant ATB 1] and [Dual Awoken Spellblade Mode II (Steiner)], removes [Dual Awoken Spellblade Mode I (Steiner)]

description.name: Instant ATB 1
description.text: Increase ATB charge speed by x9999999

description.name: Dual Awoken Spellblade Mode II (Steiner)
description.text: Increases the damage/healing cap by 20000, Spellblade abilities deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, Spellblade abilities trigger 1 additional time, cast speed x2.00 for Spellblade abilities, casts Dual Loyal Spellblade after using Spellblade abilities (max 1)

description.name: Dual Loyal Spellblade
description.text: One single attack (2.57) capped at 99999, causes [DEF, RES and MND -70% (8s)] if 0-3 FF9 allies are alive, grants [ATK, DEF, MAG and RES +30% (8s)] to all allies if 4+ FF9 allies are alive

description.name: Tri-Element Mode II (Fire, Ice, Lightning)
description.text: Grants [Attach Fire with Stacking]/[Attach Ice with Stacking]/[Attach Lightning with Stacking] after using a Fire/Ice/Lightning ability
